# PortalDex — complete description

PortalDex is an iPhone and Android app by Jensen Innovation (Klaus Jensen) for toys-to-life collectors. It is an unofficial fan app. Store links: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6779376140 and https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.portaldex.app.

## Frequently asked questions
**What is PortalDex?** PortalDex is an iPhone and Android app for toys-to-life collectors. It tracks Skylanders figures, Skylanders cards, amiibo, Disney Infinity and LEGO Dimensions in one app.
**Does PortalDex need an account or internet?** No. It works fully offline with no account, no ads and no tracking. Your collection stays on your device.
**Which languages does PortalDex support?** English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean and Chinese (Simplified and Traditional).
**Does PortalDex show what my figures are worth?** It includes an indicative, community-maintained price guide with loose and boxed values in 16 currencies.
**Can I export my collection?** Yes, as CSV or PDF — useful for backups, insurance and trading.
**Is PortalDex official?** No. It is an independent fan app by Jensen Innovation and is not affiliated with Activision, Nintendo, Disney, the LEGO Group or Topps.

## Skylanders collection tracker
Page: https://www.jensen-innovation.com/portaldex/skylanders/

PortalDex has a complete checklist of Skylanders figures from all six games, so you can see exactly which ones you own and which you are still missing.

- All six games: Spyro's Adventure, Giants, SWAP Force, Trap Team, SuperChargers and Imaginators.
- 588 catalog entries: characters plus collector variants (Legendary, Eon's Elite, LightCore, Dark, Series 2 and 3 reposes, chase and event editions), 60 traps, 36 vehicles, 29 creation crystals, magic items, adventure packs and trophies.
- Each figure's About page shows its element, game, catchphrase, attacks, Soul Gem and Wow Pow abilities, upgrade paths and tips for telling variants apart.
- SWAP Force swappers are tracked as one figure; Imaginators Senseis show their battle class; SuperChargers vehicles show land, sea or sky.
- Android: hold a figure against your phone to identify it with NFC (phones with a MIFARE Classic–capable NFC chip).
- Completion by game and element, missing list, duplicates, wishlist, notes and an indicative price guide.

**Is there an app to track my Skylanders collection?** Yes. PortalDex is an iPhone and Android app with a complete Skylanders checklist for all six games. You mark what you own and it shows your completion and what is missing.
**Can I scan Skylanders figures with my phone?** On Android, yes: PortalDex reads Skylanders figures with NFC on phones whose NFC chip supports MIFARE Classic. Not every phone does; on those phones you add figures manually. iPhone uses manual adding.
**Does PortalDex include variants like Legendary and Eon's Elite?** Yes — Legendary, Eon's Elite, LightCore, Dark, Series 2/3 reposes, chase and event variants are separate entries, so you can track each one.

## Skylanders cards checklist
Page: https://www.jensen-innovation.com/portaldex/skylanders-cards/

PortalDex includes a full checklist of Skylanders cards, so you can track your Topps trading cards, Battlecast cards and the stat cards that came with your figures.

- 1,238 cards in 8 sets.
- Topps Skylanders Giants (2012, 212 cards), Topps Skylanders SWAP Force (2013, 231), Topps Skylanders Trap Team (2014, 202).
- Skylanders Battlecast (2016, 306 cards) with element and rarity (Common, Rare, Epic, Ultimate); silver and gold foils noted.
- Figure cards packed with the toys: Spyro's Adventure (49), Giants (65), SWAP Force (84) and Trap Team (89). Completion counts these 287 figure cards.
- Cards are sorted in checklist order by printed number, and character cards link to their Skylanders figure (and back).

**Is there a checklist app for Skylanders trading cards?** Yes. PortalDex lists all 1,238 Skylanders cards — Topps Giants, SWAP Force and Trap Team, Skylanders Battlecast and the figure cards — and tracks which ones you own per set.
**Does PortalDex include Skylanders Battlecast cards?** Yes, all 306 Battlecast cards with their element and rarity.

## Amiibo collection tracker
Page: https://www.jensen-innovation.com/portaldex/amiibo/

PortalDex tracks your amiibo next to your other toys-to-life collections, with the full lineup across every amiibo series.

- 281 amiibo across every amiibo series — figures, yarn figures, cards and more.
- Each amiibo shows its series, format and North American release date.
- Android: identify amiibo with NFC.
- Completion by series, missing list, wishlist, duplicates and an indicative price guide.

**Is there an offline app to track my amiibo collection?** Yes. PortalDex works fully offline, with no account, and lists 281 amiibo by series.

## Disney infinity collection tracker
Page: https://www.jensen-innovation.com/portaldex/disney-infinity/

PortalDex has a complete Disney Infinity checklist for all three editions, including power discs and play sets.

- 326 items across Disney Infinity 1.0, 2.0 and 3.0.
- Figures (incl. rare and exclusive variants), play set pieces, 181 power discs and toy box games.
- Power discs show their effect, shape and series.
- Android: identify Disney Infinity figures with NFC on supported phones.

**Is there an app to track Disney Infinity figures and power discs?** Yes. PortalDex lists 326 Disney Infinity items — figures, play set pieces, power discs and toy box games — across 1.0, 2.0 and 3.0.

## Lego dimensions collection tracker
Page: https://www.jensen-innovation.com/portaldex/lego-dimensions/

PortalDex tracks every LEGO Dimensions character, vehicle and gadget and tells you which pack you need for the ones you are missing.

- 352 characters, vehicles and gadgets from every LEGO Dimensions world.
- Each item shows its pack (Starter, Level, Team, Fun or Story Pack) and number, wave, release date and abilities.
- Vehicles show all three rebuilds.
- "Which pack do I need" guide.
- Android: identify LEGO Dimensions characters and vehicles with NFC.

**Is there an app to track my LEGO Dimensions collection?** Yes. PortalDex lists 352 LEGO Dimensions characters, vehicles and gadgets with their packs and abilities, and shows which pack you need.
